answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, creating an economic meadow where identity is anchored to stake rather than IP addresses. An attacker launching a falcon strike against the network must acquire a majority of total supply, triggering a price spiral that exponentially increases the cost of acquiring further control. This financial barrier forces the adversary to burn significant wealth to gain influence, rendering large-scale identity spoofing irrational.
